tobacco-road-1.what: Low sun through a screen of pines onto the 11th green, with sandy waste ground and wire grass in the foreground.

tobacco-road-2.what: Portrait view up the long approach on the par-5 13th, a river of sand and grass islands running toward a white tower on the skyline.

tobacco-road-3.what: Autumn drone view over the 3rd, its green and scattered sand pits cut into a hillside of orange and gold hardwoods.

tobacco-road-4.what: Tot Hill Farm's 2nd hole seen past a cluster of huge granite boulders, the green beyond a rocky scrub carry.

bethpage-black-1.what: Low aerial of a foursome walking up a broad fairway lined with ragged-edged bunkers toward the clubhouse in early-autumn light.
bethpage-black-1.credit: NYS Dept. of Economic Development (gallery credit; ESD 2012 file)
bethpage-black-1.hole: Unknown (likely a Black finishing hole toward the clubhouse; UNVERIFIED)

bethpage-black-2.what: The famous railing sign by the Black's first tee ('The Black Course Is An Extremely Difficult Course...') with the course falling away behind it.
bethpage-black-2.credit: NY State Parks (no credit shown on image)

bethpage-black-3.what: Overhead drone shot of a small green ringed by five big white-sand bunkers, the island-in-sand look Bethpage is known for.
bethpage-black-3.credit: NY State Parks (no credit shown on image)

bethpage-black-4.what: Fog lying over a bunkered fairway at blue hour, the lit clubhouse glowing on the far ridge.
bethpage-black-4.credit: NY State Parks (no credit shown on image)

old-macdonald-1.what: A green perched above the Pacific under big cumulus clouds, with a ragged-edged bunker and dune grass in the foreground.
old-macdonald-1.hole: Unknown (No. 7 'Ocean' is the hole that climbs toward the sea; UNVERIFIED)

old-macdonald-2.what: Portrait view from a high dune over hazy, sunlit links ground with a flag and pale sand in the hollows.

old-macdonald-3.what: Sun setting behind a dune ridge and Old Macdonald's bleached 'ghost tree' snag, the course in silhouette.

old-macdonald-4.what: A huge sleeper-faced cross bunker cuts across a wide rolling fairway, with dunes, gorse and a strip of Pacific beyond.
old-macdonald-4.hole: Unknown (possibly No. 6 'Long', whose cross bunker sits 100 yds short of the green; UNVERIFIED)

sweetens-cove-1.what: October view across the 5th from near the 4th: rolling fairway, a cart path and scattered oaks under the Cumberland Plateau ridges.
sweetens-cove-1.credit: Not shown (press-page thumbnail on club site)

sweetens-cove-2.what: Golfers in Adirondack chairs around a fire pit under string lights at dusk, the floodlit course behind.

sweetens-cove-3.what: Top-down drone shot of the 4th green's big contoured surface, with pockmarked sand to the right and water to the left.

sweetens-cove-4.what: A shaggy-lipped sand bunker in the foreground, a flag on the green beyond and green mountain ridges behind.

landmand-1.what: Golden-hour drone view over rumpled Loess Hills fairways and a winding cart path to the clubhouse and flag on the ridge, farmland to the horizon.
landmand-1.credit: Brandon Carter (@offthemownpath, per filename and site credit)

landmand-2.what: A yellow windsock flag on a green at sunset, sun rays breaking through clouds over the hills.

landmand-3.what: Warm-light aerial of a huge bunker-studded green complex in a valley, wrapped by a looping path and golden harvested fields.
landmand-3.credit: Scott Brooks (@pnw_golfer, per filename and site credit)

landmand-4.what: Low pass over mown-stripe native rough toward a green set in rolling hills with autumn trees on the horizon.

erin-hills-1.what: Elevated view over a large green and ragged-edged bunker toward rolling fescue hills, ponds and a winding path at sunset.

erin-hills-2.what: A group of golfers and caddies walks down a sloping fairway in low evening light, with fescue-covered ridges and a lone oak behind.

erin-hills-3.what: A dirt walking path cuts through waist-high golden fescue toward a bunkered green in morning haze.

erin-hills-4.what: Aerial view of tees, fairway and winding paths running through rolling glacial terrain covered in tan fescue.

whistling-straits-1.what: A group putts on a green perched on a bluff above Lake Michigan, with the shoreline curving away and dunes in golden light.

whistling-straits-2.what: The par-3 17th ("Pinched Nerve") green on the lakeside bluff, framed by bunkered dunes in golden light.

whistling-straits-3.what: The par-3 3rd green on a bluff edge with mist hanging over the Lake Michigan shoreline beyond.

whistling-straits-4.what: Fog rolls off Lake Michigan over the edge of the 8th hole at dawn.

bandon-trails-1.what: From an elevated tee, the 14th fairway drops into a bowl ringed by scrub and tall coastal forest.

bandon-trails-2.what: Sand dunes and marram grass in golden light beside a fairway on the opening dune holes.

bandon-trails-3.what: Low sun bursts through a wall of dark forest behind a green.

bandon-trails-4.what: A tee sits in coastal scrub with a sandy walking path winding toward a distant green.

cabot-cliffs-1.what: Golfers walk and putt on greens atop a red-rock sea cliff in golden light, waves breaking on the rocks below.

cabot-cliffs-2.what: A golfer carrying his own bag walks up the 14th fairway past a rocky mound, forest behind.

cabot-cliffs-3.what: Aerial view of greens on top of tall red and white cliffs with a long beach and the Cape Breton highlands beyond.

cabot-cliffs-4.what: Small figures of golfers stand on the 16th green atop a sheer cliff of white and dark rock above the sea.

kiawah-ocean-course-1.what: Aerial of the 14th green set in sandy dunes and waste areas right above the beach and Atlantic in evening light.

kiawah-ocean-course-2.what: Sunset aerial of fairways between salt-marsh creeks and the Atlantic beach.

kiawah-ocean-course-3.what: Low aerial over the bunkered sandy waste area short of the 18th green with the ocean on the horizon.

kiawah-ocean-course-4.what: Low sun over the ocean behind a lagoon that wraps a green and white sand bunkers.

wekopa-saguaro-1.what: Elevated view down a Saguaro fairway and bunkered green in low golden light, palo verde and saguaros between holes, bare desert mountains behind.

wekopa-saguaro-2.what: Saguaros silhouetted against a low sun with a spiny cholla in the foreground and hazy desert ridges behind; no golf in frame (blog header).

wekopa-saguaro-3.what: Fairway and green under a big sky with saguaros and a long blue mountain range behind.

wekopa-saguaro-4.what: Drone view of narrow green fairways threaded through open Sonoran desert scrub, with distant mountain ranges and a few far-off buildings on the horizon.

silvies-valley-ranch-1.what: Sun setting over the valley behind a bunkered green framed by sagebrush, scattered pines and long hills.

silvies-valley-ranch-2.what: A golfer hits a shot while a handler holds a goat carrying a leather golf bag, pine hills behind.

silvies-valley-ranch-3.what: A bull elk with a herd of cows on open grassland, forested hills and mountains behind.

silvies-valley-ranch-4.what: Aerial of a creek snaking in tight meanders across a broad dry valley floor under scattered cloud (ranch landscape, no golf).

black-mesa-1.what: Low golden light across a fairway with eroded badland ridges, sagebrush and a long mesa under cloud.

black-mesa-2.what: A dark basalt-capped mesa rising over a fairway, desert scrub in the foreground, deep blue sky.

black-mesa-3.what: Wide panorama of a green beside a reed-fringed pond, below pale eroded cliffs dotted with juniper.

black-mesa-4.what: A dirt cart path curling down through a green valley between sage-covered hills.

northwood-1.what: Morning mist and light shafts among tall redwood trunks at the edge of a fairway.

sand-valley-1.what: Soft evening light over rolling fairways, sandy blowout bunkers and scrubby dunes with oak and pine woods behind.

sand-valley-2.what: A wide green with sand faces beyond under a streaked orange sunset.

sand-valley-3.what: Wooden Adirondack chairs looking over the course as sun rays break through heavy cloud.

sand-valley-4.what: A monarch butterfly on a purple blazing-star wildflower, soft-focus prairie behind (no golf).

hero.what: A lone golfer mid-backswing on a crest of fairway at dusk, bag lying beside him, wide pale sky above.

open-mind.what: Autumn drone view over the 3rd, its green and scattered sand pits cut into a hillside of orange and gold hardwoods.

open-body.what: Sun rises over the highlands and a forested valley, lighting the cliff edge and course above the shore.

open-spirit.what: Sunburst over a wide valley, a green half-hidden among sagebrush and lone pines.
